title: Fortnite
source: other_modules: tombox-probe load (crates/tombox-probe, tools/verify/run_chatprobe.ps1): title module staged outside the dump, LoadLibraryExW in a child process, every delay import resolved via ResolveDelayLoadedAPI / GetProcAddress; CONCRT140 resolved against a staged host VC++ 14.x redist concrt140.dll because Fortnite ships none; this is a load probe, not a game run; GameChat2.dll: tools/progress/chatprobe.py: Fortnite's own GameChat2.dll (2008.4) loaded on PC in two peer processes, each a copied python host with its own tombox.cfg xuid so the emulated XUser (gdk QueryApiImpl, routed into the delay-loaded GameChat2 by the gdk late-load hook) is the local user added with ChatManagerAddLocalUser; net_guard builtin backend redirects every host to the in-process loopback server; console path (XSystemGetAnalyticsInfo family 'Windows.Xbox'): AudioHALWrapper loaded in both peers, the RTA websocket (rta.xboxlive.com.V2) connected with 2/2 subscriptions acked, 5/5 Xbox Live requests (social people, privacy permission/validate, profile SpeechAccessibility, userstats reputation) answered with JSON, signed with XSTS v1 P-256 signatures, none unhandled; data frames relayed (A->B 10, B->A 7, control traffic only, no microphone audio); voice codec path proven separately through the emulator AudioHALWrapper.dll exports with libopus opus.dll and SKP_SILK_SDK.dll on a synthesized 440 Hz tone, 50 x 20 ms frames at 24 kHz: opus 2801 bytes, tone amp 7916.5, SNR 30.2 dB, silk 2607 bytes, tone amp 7937.8, SNR 35.8 dB; Fortnite's ChatManagerInitialize arguments (1.0, relationship 9, restrictive, STT automatic, no manipulation) and 24 kbps bitrate; passed: ChatManagerAddLocalUser, ChatManagerAddRemoteUser, ChatManagerCleanup, ChatManagerInitialize, ChatManagerRemoveUser, ChatManagerSetAudioEncodingBitrate, ChatUserGetIsLocal, ChatUserGetRemoteUserMuted, ChatUserSetMicrophoneMuted, ChatUserSetRemoteUserMuted, codec_done, codec_opus, codec_silk, console_path, done
